name: db-regen-verify
description: 重新生成 msgdb 数据库，使用 output/system-usage-guide.md 进行验证，对比修复前后的差异

members.name: builder
members.role: Build and run msgdb-dump to regenerate the database

tasks.subject: Build msgdb-dump and regenerate database
tasks.description:
Build the msgdb-dump tool and regenerate the database with all fixes applied.

Steps:
1. Set GO111MODULE=on
2. cd msgdb-dump
3. go build -o msgdb-dump-final.exe .
4. Run the tool to regenerate the database:
   .\msgdb-dump-final.exe --out-dir ..\output --lang 1033,2052
5. Report the output including:
   - Number of DLLs scanned
   - Number of providers found
   - Number of messages extracted
   - Database file path and size
   - Any warnings or errors

Note: The tool requires Windows registry access, so it must run on Windows.

tasks.subject: Verify regenerated DB against system-usage-guide.md
tasks.description:
Verify the regenerated database against output/system-usage-guide.md.

Check:
1. Database schema matches V5 (provider_messages table)
2. Kernel-Power EventID 566 has correct parameter mappings (not hardcoded)
3. Message count comparison with previous database
4. Database metadata is correct (schema_version=5, langs, build_number)
5. Run any verification scripts mentioned in the guide
6. Compare with the test cases in the guide (MT-001, PS-001, LD-001)
7. Report any discrepancies

The guide mentions:
- MT-001: EventID 16 message template selection
- PS-001: EventID 566 parameter encoding (Kernel-Power)
- LD-001: EVTX original level priority
